content.title: About
content.content: An empanada is a traditional fried or baked pastry filled with meat, cheese, vegetables or sweet fillings. Product NFS (No. 3470) is sold as ready‑to‑heat portions, vacuum‑sealed for convenience.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Empanadas originate from Spanish and Latin American cuisines, where they are known by many names.
The original dough is made from wheat flour, water, oil and a small amount of yeast.
Fillings can be savory (beef, chicken, cheese) or sweet (apple, ricotta, chocolate).
In Russia empanadas became popular in the 1990s thanks to imported brands.
NFS (3470) is designed for quick microwave preparation in 2–3 minutes.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Meat or cheese fillings provide high‑quality protein needed for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Meat fillings are rich in heme iron, which is more readily absorbed than plant iron.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The dough and meat fillings supply vitamins B1, B2, B3 and B6, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Carbohydrates for energy
items.content: Wheat dough delivers quick‑release carbs that give an immediate energy boost.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: When vegetables are included in the filling, the empanada adds useful fiber for digestion.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: Fried empanadas can contain a notable amount of saturated fat, so they should be eaten in moderation.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: Ready‑made products often contain added salt, which may be a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: The dough may contain gluten and the fillings dairy; individuals with these allergies should check the label.

items.title: Thermal safety
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave meat fillings undercooked, posing a bacterial risk.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the empanada in the microwave (or oven) according to the package instructions, then enjoy it hot. It works as a quick snack, a meal, or a side to a salad.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the sealed package refrigerated at +2…+6 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–4 days. Do not freeze, as it may alter the dough texture.
